data.name: Holiday Inn Express Puerto Vallarta
data.address: Blvd. Francisco Medina Ascencio 3974, Villa Las Flores, 48356 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Amid commercial properties, this relaxed hotel is 1 km from Licenciado Gustavo Díaz Ordaz International Airport and the Marina Vallarta Club de Golf, and 2 km from the beaches of Costalegre.
The streamlined rooms offer free Wi-Fi, safes and flat-screen TVs, plus tea and coffeemakers. Suites add microwaves, minifridges, and wet bars, as well as separate living rooms with pull-out sofas; some have dining tables and terraces.
Complimentary amenities include parking, and a breakfast buffet served in an airy dining room. There's also a fitness center, an outdoor pool with city views, and a hot tub.
